quicify.quicify.desc: Blazing fast QUIC transport for Minecraft networking
quicify.quicify.serverPort.desc: UDP port of the server-side QUIC listener, 0 reuses the Minecraft TCP port (recommended)
quicify.quicify.connectMode.desc: AUTO uses QUIC when the server advertises it (TCP fallback otherwise), FORCE_TCP never attempts QUIC, FORCE_QUIC refuses to connect when QUIC fails
quicify.quicify.multiplexing.desc: Spread packets over several QUIC streams so chunk transfers stop delaying chat and movement
quicify.quicify.datagrams.desc: Send sounds, particles and animations as unreliable QUIC datagrams so a lost one is never retransmitted or blocking
quicify.quicify.compressionLevel.desc: zstd compression level used when sending, higher trades CPU for a better ratio
quicify.quicify.compressionWindowLog.des: Base 2 logarithm of the compression history kept per stream, higher trades memory for a better ratio
quicify.quicify.connectTimeoutMs.desc: How long the client waits for a QUIC handshake before falling back to TCP
quicify.quicify.verbose.desc: Extra logging about QUIC connection attempts and fallbacks (for development purposes)
